Technology would move from 56.6% to 53.8%; Communication services from 12.0% to 11.4%; and Consumer cyclical from 8.4% to 7.9%.","In the crash replays, the worst fall would change from 54.2% ($98,155) to 52.4% ($94,837) for the 2008–09 crisis; from 31.2% ($56,596) to 30.1% ($54,471) for Covid; and from 31.4% ($56,813) to 29.9% ($54,089) for 2022.","The historical data shows large falls from peak to bottom: 55.2% in the 2008–09 crisis and 33.7% in the Covid crash. After those bottoms, the market gained 71.9% and 77.5%, respectively, in the following year; those past gains illustrate how selling near a bottom could mean missing a subsequent rise, while buying near a peak came before a decline.","The past recovery times shown were 41.3 months after the 2008–09 crisis bottom and 4.6 months after the Covid bottom. You have 23 years to retirement; those historical recovery periods provide context, not a forecast."]}
